headlines.title: The Bull Case For Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Could Change Following CEO Shift And 2027 Beverage Push
headlines.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper recently announced that current Chief Executive Officer Tim Cofer will lead the planned North America-focused Beverage Co following the company’s separation into two businesses. The appointment comes as Keurig Dr Pepper accelerates product innovation and marketing for its 2027 lineup, including new energy, functional, and core soft drink offerings designed to match evolving consumer tastes.

headlines.title: Can Keurig Dr Pepper's Planned 2027 Split Drive Long-Term Value?
headlines.summary: KDP's planned 2027 split aims to unlock long-term value through focused growth, debt reduction and $400 million in coffee cost synergies.

headlines.title: Keurig Dr Pepper Earnings Preview: What to Expect
headlines.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper is set to report its Q3 earnings next month, with analysts expecting double-digit year-over-year growth in EPS.

headlines.title: Keurig Reimagines Coffee Without the Plastic. Don’t Worry, Your K-Cup Still Lives.
headlines.summary: Keurig is rolling out a line of single-serve coffee rounds made of compressed grounds encased in a seaweed-based coating. They look like mini hockey pucks.

headlines.title: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Could Be 14% Undervalued As Split Plans Take Shape
headlines.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) is back in focus after the company said Chief Executive Officer Tim Cofer will lead the planned Beverage Co unit following its separation. Recent trading has been choppy for Keurig Dr Pepper, with a 1-day share price return of 2.36% and a 7-day share price return of 1.86% offset by a 30-day share price decline of 3.96%. Yet year to date the share price return is 12.73%, and the 1-year total shareholder return of 24.

description: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. owns, manufactures, and distributors beverages and single serve brewing systems in the United States and internationally. The company operates through three segments: U.S. Refreshment Beverages, U.S. Coffee, and International. It manufactures and distributes branded concentrates, syrup, and finished beverages, as well as sales of owned brands and third-party brands; tea, cocoa, and other products; and offers finished goods relating to K-Cup pods, single serve brewers, specialty coffee, and ready to drink coffee products. The company offers its products under the Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, Snapple, 7UP, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Clamato, Core Hydration, The Original Donut Shop, Sunkist soda, Squirt, C4 Energy, Hawaiian Punch, Electrolit, Bloom, Bai, Evian, Yoo-Hoo, Vita Coco, Big Red, RC Cola, Crush, McCafé, Tim Hortons, Van Houtte, Celestial Seasonings, Bigelow, Starbucks, Dunkin', Folgers, Peet's, and Swiss Miss brands, as well as other partner and private label brands. It markets and sells its products to supermarkets, mass merchandisers, club stores, e-commerce retailers, office superstores, vending machines, fountains, grocery and drug stores, convenience stores, and other small outlets; and directly to consumers through Keurig.com website. Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Frisco, Texas.
